19:   store: ReviewStore,
20:   api: SplitterReviewApi,
21:   runId: string,
22:   blockId: string,
23:   input: Review,
24: ) {
25:   const state = store.getState();
26:   if (state.busy) throw new Error("Wait for the current run action to finish.");
27:   try {
28:     const review = SplitterReview.parse(input);
29:     const report = reportForStep(state.run, blockId);
30:     if (state.run?.id !== runId || !report || !splitterReviewGate(state.run, blockId))
31:       throw new Error(
32:         "Routing corrections require an editable paused HIL gate upstream of continuation.",
33:       );
34:     if (review.expectedVersion !== report.reviews.length)
35:       throw new Error(
36:         "Review version changed. Read the latest saved report before correcting a route.",
37:       );
38:     for (const change of review.changes) {
39:       const assignment = report.assignments.find((item) => item.itemId === change.itemId);
40:       if (!assignment || !report.branches.some((branch) => branch.portId === change.toPortId))
41:         throw new Error("Choose an item and output from the saved report.");
42:       if (assignment.outputPortId === change.toPortId)
43:         throw new Error("Choose a different output.");
44:     }
45:     if (!api.reviewSplitter)
46:       throw new Error("Routing correction is not available in this app version.");
47:     store.setState({ busy: true, error: null });
48:     const saved = WorkflowRun.parse(await api.reviewSplitter(runId, blockId, review));
49:     const savedReport = reportForStep(saved, blockId);
50:     if (saved.id !== runId || !savedReport || savedReport.reviews.length <= review.expectedVersion)
51:       throw new Error(
52:         "The server did not return a persisted routing correction. Reload the run before retrying.",
53:       );

58:       (reportForStep(current, blockId)?.reviews.length ?? 0) <= savedReport.reviews.length &&
59:       current.status === "waiting_for_review"

62:     return saved;
63:   } catch (err) {
64:     store.setState({ error: err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err) });
